answer: Re-attestations are stored in reef and ferrous lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the prism graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1848 impostors cost 448 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
